title: Catalog Titles by Literary Author
description_markdown: Circulation request: Join `books` with `authors` on `author_id`. Return `b.title`, `a.name AS author_name`, and `b.publication_year`. Order by `b.publication_year` ASC, `b.title` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Catalog query
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT b.title, a.name AS author_name, b.publication_year FROM books b JOIN authors a ON b.author_id = a.author_id ORDER BY b.publication_year ASC, b.title ASC;
solution_explanation: Joins library title inventory with bibliographic author records.
hints: Join on `b.author_id = a.author_id`.
Focus on the required WHERE, JOIN, or GROUP BY clause conditions.
Query: SELECT b.title, a.name AS author_name, b.publication_year FROM books b JOIN authors a ON b.author_id = a.author_id ORDER BY b.publication_year ASC, b.title ASC;

title: Identify Active Overdue or Borrowed Volumes
description_markdown: Librarian request: Find all currently checked-out books that have not yet been returned (`returned_date IS NULL`). Return `b.title`, `m.name AS member_name`, `bl.loan_date`, and `bl.due_date`. Order by `bl.due_date` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Checked-out titles
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT b.title, m.name AS member_name, bl.loan_date, bl.due_date FROM book_loans bl JOIN books b ON bl.book_id = b.book_id JOIN members m ON bl.member_id = m.member_id WHERE bl.returned_date IS NULL ORDER BY bl.due_date ASC, b.title ASC;
solution_explanation: Filters loans where `returned_date IS NULL` to locate open loans.
hints: Use `WHERE bl.returned_date IS NULL`.
Focus on the required WHERE, JOIN, or GROUP BY clause conditions.

Query: SELECT b.title, m.name AS member_name, bl.loan_date, bl.due_date FROM book_loans bl JOIN books b ON bl.book_id = b.book_id JOIN members m ON bl.member_id = m.member_id WHERE bl.returned_date IS NULL ORDER BY bl.due_date ASC, b.title ASC;

title: Member Circulation Activity Volume
description_markdown: Patron services request: Count total book loans per library member as `total_loans`. Return `m.name`, `m.email`, and `total_loans`. Filter for members with `total_loans >= 1`. Order by `total_loans` DESC, `m.member_id` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Member loan activity
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT m.name, m.email, COUNT(bl.loan_id) AS total_loans FROM members m JOIN book_loans bl ON m.member_id = bl.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.name, m.email HAVING COUNT(bl.loan_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_loans DESC, m.member_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Quantifies member borrowing frequency.
hints: Group by member and count loans.
Focus on the required WHERE, JOIN, or GROUP BY clause conditions.

Query: SELECT m.name, m.email, COUNT(bl.loan_id) AS total_loans FROM members m JOIN book_loans bl ON m.member_id = bl.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.name, m.email HAVING COUNT(bl.loan_id) >= 1 ORDER BY total_loans DESC, m.member_id ASC;

title: Calculate Average Publication Era by Author Origin

starter_query:

title: Classify Literary Titles by Historical Era

solution_explanation: Uses CASE expression to map publication_year into eras.
hints: Use `CASE WHEN publication_year < 1900 THEN 'Pre-20th Century' ... END`.

title: Track Successive Member Checkout Dates Using LEAD
description_markdown: For each loan, determine the checkout date of the member's next subsequent loan as `next_loan_date` using `LEAD()`. Return `loan_id`, `member_id`, `loan_date`, and `next_loan_date`. Order by `member_id` ASC, `loan_date` ASC, `loan_id` ASC.

-- Write your solution query here

solution_query: SELECT loan_id, member_id, loan_date, LEAD(loan_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY loan_date ASC, loan_id ASC) AS next_loan_date FROM book_loans ORDER BY member_id ASC, loan_date ASC, loan_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Applies LEAD(loan_date, 1) partitioned by member_id.
hints: Use `LEAD(loan_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY loan_date ASC, loan_id ASC)`.
Order by `member_id` ASC, `loan_date` ASC, `loan_id` ASC.

Query: SELECT loan_id, member_id, loan_date, LEAD(loan_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY loan_date ASC, loan_id ASC) AS next_loan_date FROM book_loans ORDER BY member_id ASC, loan_date ASC, loan_id ASC;

Query: SELECT bl.loan_id, b.title AS book_title, a.name AS author_name, m.name AS member_name, bl.loan_date FROM book_loans bl JOIN books b ON bl.book_id = b.book_id JOIN authors a ON b.author_id = a.author_id JOIN members m ON bl.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY bl.loan_id ASC;

title: Filter Authors Whose Works Have Active or Past Loans
